decisions.question: Rounding .x5 overall scores half-up can move a project across a maturity threshold; approve the change (it alters some existing rollups)?
Pin the grading CI to an exact kit version and hash (so users upgrade it deliberately), instead of following the website's latest?
Let the grading CI read each project's code repo (with a read token for private code) to verify citations?
Change what init writes to project.toml (preset answers as comments instead of explicit answers)?
Add third-party license notices to the website-with-Pyodide release zip (a licensing change to a published artifact)?
Install the grading CI workflow in this repository's .github/workflows (it gets contents: write on the decide and index jobs)?
decisions.answer: Install it on the grading/code-grader branch only, not on main: reports stay off main.

decisions.question: Stop counting the report PR's author (the grader) as a person who can approve its own decision questions?
decisions.answer: A grader opens the PR with its user's own token, so ignoring the author's ticks would lock the owner out; agent answers are already gated by allow_agent_decisions.
